_comment: 清理优化页签 —— 8 个全部接上真功能。清空回收站 / 清理临时文件 / 一键清理垃圾 / 清理浏览器缓存 会真的删东西，所以都是二次确认；磁盘清理、存储感知、启动项、大文件查找 只是打开对应窗口或只读扫描。

tools.name: 一键清理垃圾
tools.hint: 清理临时文件 + 清空回收站（不含浏览器缓存）
tools.inline: $n=0;$b=0;$t=@($env:TEMP,[System.IO.Path]::Combine($env:SystemRoot,'Temp'));foreach($d in $t){Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|ForEach-Object{try{$s=0;if(-not $_.PSIsContainer){$s=$_.Length};Remove-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$n++;$b+=$s}catch{}}};$r='回收站';try{Clear-RecycleBin -Force -ErrorAction Stop;$r='回收站已清空'}catch{$r='回收站跳过（已经空的或读不到）'};'临时文件：清理 '+$n+' 项，约 '+[math]::Round($b/1MB,1)+' MB' + [Environment]::NewLine + $r

tools.name: 清理临时文件
tools.hint: 清用户临时目录和 Windows\Temp，正在用的文件会自动跳过
tools.inline: $n=0;$b=0;$t=@($env:TEMP,[System.IO.Path]::Combine($env:SystemRoot,'Temp'));foreach($d in $t){Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $d -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|ForEach-Object{try{$s=0;if(-not $_.PSIsContainer){$s=$_.Length};Remove-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$n++;$b+=$s}catch{}}};'清理 '+$n+' 项，约 '+[math]::Round($b/1MB,1)+' MB（正在使用的文件已跳过）：'+($t -join '，')

tools.name: 清空回收站
tools.hint: 删掉回收站里的全部内容，删了就找不回来了
tools.inline: try{Clear-RecycleBin -Force -ErrorAction Stop;'回收站已清空'}catch{'回收站本来就是空的（或读不到：'+$_.Exception.Message+'）'}

tools.name: 清理浏览器缓存
tools.hint: 先关掉浏览器再点。按注册表里真实的默认浏览器找缓存目录，便携版（绿色版）也能认出来
tools.inline: $names=@('msedge','chrome','firefox','brave','opera','360se','QQBrowser','SogouExplorer');$run=@(Get-Process -Name $names -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue);if($run.Count -gt 0){'请先关闭浏览器：'+(($run|Select-Object -ExpandProperty ProcessName -Unique) -join '、');exit 0};$id=(Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Shell\Associations\UrlAssociations\http\UserChoice' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProgId;$q=[char]34;$exe='';if($id){foreach($root in @('HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Classes','HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Classes')){$p=$root+'\'+$id+'\shell\open\command';$v=(Get-ItemProperty -Path $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).'(default)';if($v){$v=([string]$v).Trim();if($v.StartsWith([string]$q)){$exe=$v.Split($q)[1]}else{$exe=($v -split ' ')[0]};if($exe){break}}}};$roots=New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList;if($exe -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe)){$d=Split-Path -Parent $exe;$up=Split-Path -Parent $d;foreach($c in @(($d+'\User Data'),($up+'\User Data'),($d+'\Cache'),($up+'\Cache'),($up+'\Data'))){if((Test-Path -LiteralPath $c) -and -not $roots.Contains($c)){[void]$roots.Add($c)}}};foreach($c in @((Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Google\Chrome\User Data'),(Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Microsoft\Edge\User Data'),(Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\User Data'))){if((Test-Path -LiteralPath $c) -and -not $roots.Contains($c)){[void]$roots.Add($c)}};$ff=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles';$leaves=@('Cache','Code Cache','GPUCache','Media Cache','cache2','ShaderCache','GrShaderCache','GraphiteDawnCache');$n=0;$b=0;$seen=@();foreach($r in $roots){foreach($dir in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $r -Directory -Recurse -Depth 1 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$leaves -contains $_.Name})){if($seen -contains $dir.FullName){continue};$seen+=$dir.FullName;$s=(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir.FullName -Recurse -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum;if(-not $s){$s=0};Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dir.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$n++;$b+=$s}};if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $ff){foreach($dir in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $ff -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)){$c2=Join-Path $dir.FullName 'cache2';if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $c2){$s=(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $c2 -Recurse -File -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum;if(-not $s){$s=0};Remove-Item -LiteralPath $c2 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;$n++;$b+=$s}}};$who='没有识别出默认浏览器';if($exe){$who=$exe};if($n -eq 0){'没找到可清理的缓存目录。'+[Environment]::NewLine+'默认浏览器：'+$who+[Environment]::NewLine+'找过这些位置：'+($roots -join '，')+[Environment]::NewLine+'（浏览器装在别处、或者是便携版时，缓存目录可能不在这些位置）'}else{'已清理 '+$n+' 个缓存目录，约 '+[math]::Round($b/1MB,1)+' MB'+[Environment]::NewLine+'默认浏览器：'+$who+[Environment]::NewLine+'只删了 Cache / Code Cache / GPUCache 这类缓存目录，书签、密码、扩展、登录状态都没动'}

tools.name: 大文件查找
tools.hint: 弹窗选一个文件夹，列出它里面最大的 50 个文件
tools.inline: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms;$f=New-Object System.Windows.Forms.FolderBrowserDialog;$f.Description='选择要查找大文件的文件夹';if($f.ShowDialog() -eq [System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult]::OK){$all=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $f.SelectedPath -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue;'扫描目录：'+$f.SelectedPath;'文件总数：'+$all.Count;'';$all|Sort-Object Length -Descending|Select-Object -First 50 @{n='大小MB';e={[math]::Round($_.Length/1MB,1)}},FullName|Format-Table -AutoSize|Out-String -Width 300}else{'已取消'}
